_comment: Shown once after each update, and from Help > What's New in Loupe. One entry per release version (X.Y.Z, betas share it): a few highlights, each a ToolIcon glyph, a short title and one line. A test fails if the project version has no entry.

items.title: Tabs and windows
items.body: Open several files at once. Drag a tab to reorder it, into a window of its own, or onto another Loupe window.

items.title: Exploded view
items.body: Pull an assembly apart with handles, switch between Assembled and Exploded, and export the layout.

items.title: Updates in the app
items.body: New versions appear in the toolbar and install in place, keeping your settings.

items.title: Transparency you control
items.body: Set each part's opacity and outline, and see what is hidden or transparent in the assembly tree.

items.title: Faster sections
items.body: Large assemblies finish sectioning far sooner, and View normal looks straight at the cut.

items.title: A refined interface
items.body: A light and dark switch, drawn icons, matching panels, and part colours that tell neighbours apart.
